Duck Hunters summary

Nolimit City takes players deep into the swamp for a redneck shooting spree with the Duck Hunters slot. This hilarious and action packed release tasks you with clearing out the surplus bird population across a five by five grid. Instead of traditional paylines, this title utilizes a scatter pays engine where landing eight or more matching symbols anywhere on the board awards a payout. If you are ready to grab your gear and join Bubba for hunting season, you can easily load up the right here on Playin.com to test your aim without risking a real bankroll.

Base Game Mechanics and Features

The core gameplay revolves around chaining together massive scatter wins. Every time you connect eight or more symbols, they disappear from the grid to let new ones drop into place. Crucially, a multiplier is left behind on each empty position, starting at double its value and doubling again with consecutive hits in the exact same spot, up to a staggering 8192 times. To help you clear the board, a Bomb can detonate in a three by three radius, doubling the symbol size on affected spaces. The math model also relies heavily on signature modifiers. The xWays mechanic transforms into a regular symbol and boosts the position multiplier, while the powerful Infectious xWays will expand all identical symbols on the grid to match its size.

Bonus Rounds and Free Spins

Tracking down enough scatter targets triggers the escalating bonus tiers. Landing three bonus symbols initiates the Duck Hunt Spins, granting seven rounds where your position multipliers remain persistent. This tier also awards one random upgrade, which could be an upgraded five by five Bomb, extra shots, or an upgrade forcing all xWays to become infectious. Hitting four bonus symbols unlocks the Hawk Eye Spins, awarding eight rounds and two random upgrades. For the ultimate expedition, five bonus symbols trigger the Big Game Spins, granting ten rounds equipped with all three active upgrades. To put your swamp shooting skills to the test against other hunters, you can join a free slot tournament to compete for real rewards.

Volatility Rating and Potential

Nolimit City has classified this backwoods expedition with an Extreme volatility rating. The gameplay is highly unpredictable and dry spells are common in the swamp, but the mathematical engine carries a massive maximum payout potential of 30,000 times your base bet. Because the escalating position multipliers and symbol expansions can become incredibly complex, utilizing your virtual Playin coins is the smartest strategy to figure out how the features interact before the real pressure hits. Whether you are aiming to reach the top tier Big Game tier or simply enjoying casual free slots for a laugh at the comical theme, this title delivers a highly entertaining session.

Game Features

Scatter Wins

Payouts are awarded when 8 or more symbols of same kind land on the reel area. Winning symbols are removed and will trigger a drop on the reel allowing new symbols to drop in. A multiplier of x2 is added on each position where a symbol was removed. If a position multiplier already existed there and that position gets a win on next drop, its multiplier value gets doubled. The multiplier on a win position can reach up to x8192.

xWays® & Infectious xWays®

xWays® symbols transform into a regular paying symbol and increases the position multiplier by 2, 4 or 8 times. Infectious xWays®: The revealed xWays® symbol will infect all of the other same symbols on the reel area to expand to the same size. If more than one xWays® or Infectious xWays® symbols land, then all those symbols transform into the same symbol.

Bomb

An exploding Bomb removes adjacent regular paying symbols in a 3x3 pattern. Symbol size gets doubled on the positions affected by Bomb. All Bombs will explode before the next collapse. Bonus and Wild symbols are unaffected by the explosion

Duck Hunt Spins

Landing 3 Bonus symbols will trigger 7 Duck Hunt Spins. Position multipliers are kept during Free spins. Landing a Extra +1 Shot symbol awards +1 spin. During this feature, any 1 of the following 3 upgrades is randomly awarded. - Upgraded xWays® : xWays® symbols are replaced by Infectious xWays®. - Upgraded Bomb: An exploding Bomb removes adjacent regular paying symbols in a 5x5 pattern. - Extra +2 Shots: Replaces the Extra +1 Shot symbol and awards +2 spins upon landing.

Hawk Eye Spins

Landing 4 Bonus symbols will trigger 8 Hawk Eye Spins. It has same features like Duck Hunt Spins but 2 upgrades are randomly awarded instead.

Big Game Spins

Landing 5 Bonus symbols will trigger 10 Big Game Spins. It has same features like Hawk Eye Spins but all 3 upgrades are awarded instead.

xBet™ (Nolimit Booster)

At a cost of 2 times the base bet, the player is 5 times more likely to trigger Free Spins. Guaranteed Bonus symbol on the second reel.

Day 2 Spins (Nolimit Booster)

At a cost of 2.8 times the base bet, initial multiplier value of all positions will be x2.

Day 64 Spins (Nolimit Booster)

At a cost of 90 times the base bet, initial multiplier value of all positions will be x64.

Day 1024 Spins (Nolimit Booster)

At a cost of 3,000 times the base bet, initial multiplier value of all positions will be x1024.

Extra Spin

Players might get the opportunity to purchase an additional spin when a round ends. The additional spin will keep the position multipliers of the previous spin. The cost of the spin will be calculated based on the position multipliers. If the cost of the Extra Spin is less than or equal to the win on the previous spin, then the Extra Spin option will be presented. Bonus symbols will not land during Extra Spin.

Sky is the Limit

The max payout of the game is 30,000 times the base bet. When the total win exceeds this amount the game round will end and 30,000 times the base bet is awarded.

Game xMechanics

Infectious xWays®

Any xWays symbols that appear will reveal the same symbol, and if the symbol revealed is already visible on the reels, each in view will be ‘infected’ and will expand as if they are xWays – producing additional ways to win.

xBet®

At an extra cost per spin, the player gets an increased chance of getting into the Bonus Modes. The way this happens varies from game to game. The payout for each symbol is not affected.

xWays®

xWays® unlocks unprecedented win potential for players. Usually seen in a fixed Ways game, any xWays symbols that land reveals a stack of the same symbol, increasing the ways available to win, and when working alongside some of the other mechanics available in this series, such as xNudge or xSplit, can pave the way for some huge wins. xWays® first made an appearance in Pixies Vs Pirates, although many players will more likely recognise this mechanic from Punk Rocker, an early 2020 release. Alongside these two releases, xWays has made an appearance in a host of other NolimitCity games, including Dragon Tribe, East Coast vs West Coast, and San Quentin – the early 2021 release which rocked the community with news of a 150,000x maximum win availability.

xTra™

At the end of your round, you might get the chance to buy an extra spin without resetting your current progress. Keep your momentum and go for bigger rewards instead of starting over.
